reviewer_identity.role: Independent post-run live LLM semantic reviewer
reviewer_identity.method: Actual LLM reading and interpretation of all recorded FINAL free-text payloads, supplemented by read-only deterministic provenance checks; not a mock or rubric-only reviewer.
reviewer_identity.model: Codex host model; exact serving model identifier was not independently recorded for this review

decision_scope: Accept the semantic fidelity of the 36 frozen session answers to their own observed or injected evidence and the supplied policy. This does not validate general memory efficacy, causal improvement, economic results, or total cost savings.

sources.canonical_json_definition: UTF-8 json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False), without an appended newline
sources.database_access: SQLite mode=ro; no benchmark code, store, or result was changed
sources.private_rubric_timing: Read only after confirming all 36 FINAL events existed; answers were not rewritten or regenerated

checks.free_text_review: Observations, interpretations, unknowns, citations, and action claims were checked, not just decision labels or the causal_claim boolean. Recorded test results are reported as supplied evidence, without claiming that the answering agents executed those tests.

scope_limitations: ARM_BUNDLED comprises 12 distinct synthetic procedural tasks evaluated in three arms, not 36 independent tasks or repetitions. Shared within-arm context induces dependence; no statistical efficacy estimate follows from treating the 36 answers as independent.

All arms have the same backend source catalogs and policy. The observed read differences describe this run's action choices and supplied memory, not an effect of unequal access or a demonstrated causal benefit of memory.

B1 is a scoped flat-note ablation with review dates, limitations, source references, and explicit correction text. It is not a universal baseline for every flat-memory system or an intentionally stale-only condition.

B2's structured memory contains directly useful task facts and provenance. The small, explicit synthetic bank cannot establish performance on unfamiliar tasks, long-horizon learning, adversarial retrieval, or empirical market research.

The manifest declares LOGICAL_ONLY isolation. The event log establishes recorded packets and declared actions; this review does not certify process isolation, unlogged host behavior, hidden context absence, or the complete original model transcript.
model_tokens is null and the manifest excludes memory preparation cost. Source-read counts are not token usage, latency, total compute, or end-to-end monetary cost; no such savings are established.

The run reports no learning during evaluation, no independent repetitions, and no empirical market memory. This review does not validate future improvement or financial, factor-performance, or causal claims.

This is one independent live LLM review, not independent human adjudication or inter-reviewer reliability measurement. The private rubric was available only for post-run review, and matching its decisions alone was not treated as semantic validation.

Only the authorized manifest, public bank, read-only session database, and post-completion private rubric were inspected. Benchmark implementation, memory-store internals, market files, other experiments, and external model execution provenance were outside this review.
